persona.title: A research brief of your own
persona.purpose: Turns the most blocking gap of the diagnosis into a brief ready to paste, with criteria you can check one by one.
persona.when: you hold the step 2 diagnosis and you want to close the gap that blocks most.
persona.example: The gap on real adoption in small firms, blocking my training decision.
persona.evidence: a prompt ready for Deep Research with objective, in and out of scope, tensions, minimum evidence per claim and acceptance criteria checkable one by one, plus the justification of the gap chosen by impact.
persona.prompt: Step 3: use my prior diagnosis, do not start fresh. Choose the highest-impact gap for [RESULT] — the one blocking most claimable lines — and justify it. Turn it into a prompt ready to paste into Deep Research. Include objective, in-scope and out-of-scope questions, tensions, preferred source types, time or region for [MY CASE], minimum evidence per claim, cited format and acceptance criteria checkable one by one. Do not run the research nor hand me findings: this step only writes the brief; its answer returns as a source. Without a prior diagnosis, ask for the audit; if gaps tie or material context is missing, ask at most three questions. Do not invent gaps, findings or sources.

Turn it into a prompt ready to paste into Deep Research. Include objective, in-scope and out-of-scope questions, tensions, preferred source types, time or region, minimum evidence per claim, cited format and acceptance criteria checkable one by one; runnable by another team member with no extra context. Do not run the research nor hand over findings: this step only writes the brief. Without a diagnosis, ask for the audit; if gaps tie or context is missing, ask the accountable owner (max three). Do not invent gaps or sources.

assumptions: Existe um diagnóstico da equipe com lacunas abertas e um responsável a quem perguntar
A anatomia do encargo é herdada da pesquisa autônoma 03; lá a pesquisa é executada, aqui apenas encomendada
O Deep Research está disponível para as contas da equipe: a disponibilidade varia por plano e idade, e o prompt não a promete
limits: Gera o encargo, não executa a pesquisa nem aprova seu resultado
Não reaudita a base compartilhada nem decide suficiência: isso cabe a W02 e W04

traceability.claim: A idade mínima e a disponibilidade por plano do Deep Research obrigam a entregar o encargo como texto transferível em vez de prometer execução à equipe.
O arcabouço do encargo de pesquisa que a equipe reutiliza vem da biblioteca publicada do método.
Exigir que o encargo seja executável por outra pessoa da equipe sem contexto adicional e nomear o risco operacional da lacuna é política interna do método.
